merchant.name: Lokal Sandwich Shop
merchant.cuisine: Handcrafted Sandwiches, Vietnamese Banh Mi & Artisan Subs

items.name: Old Skool Banh Mi
items.description: Classic cold cut Vietnamese sandwich with pork loaf, ham, head cheese, pate, cucumber, jalapeño, mayo, and pickled daikon/carrots on toasted French baguette.

items.name: Grilled Chicken Banh Mi
items.description: Marinated grilled chicken breast, fresh cilantro, jalapeño, cucumber, house mayo, and pickled vegetables on crispy baguette.

items.name: K-BBQ Beef Banh Mi
items.description: Korean bulgogi marinated ribeye, sweet soy glaze, pickled daikon, cucumber, cilantro, spicy sriracha mayo.

items.name: Lemongrass Tofu Banh Mi
items.description: Crispy organic tofu sautéed in fresh lemongrass and garlic, pickled carrots, cucumber, jalapeño, and vegan cilantro mayo.

items.name: Chimichurri Steak Sandwich
items.description: Tender grilled steak, scratch chimichurri herb sauce, grilled onions, fresh tomatoes, melted pepper jack, and garlic aioli on rustic ciabatta.

items.name: Italian Job 2.0 Sub
items.description: Genoa salami, mortadella, sweet capicola, ham, provolone, wild arugula, tomato, spicy pepperoncini, and deli mustard on ciabatta.

items.name: Albacore Tuna Melt
items.description: Line-caught wild albacore tuna salad, melted sharp cheddar, sliced avocado, and beefsteak tomatoes on toasted sourdough.

items.name: Turkey Bacon Pesto Ciabatta
items.description: Roasted turkey breast, applewood smoked bacon, basil pesto, melted provolone, and mixed greens on toasted ciabatta.

items.name: Sunrise Breakfast Sandwich
items.description: Two fried eggs, melted cheddar cheese, house mayo, crisp lettuce, and ripe tomatoes on toasted ciabatta.

items.name: The Rustic Breakfast
items.description: Applewood bacon, over-easy egg, wild arugula, shaved parmesan, garlic aioli, sundried tomato, and pesto on rustic sourdough.

items.name: Vietnamese Iced Coffee (Ca Phe Sua Da)
items.description: Slow-dripped dark roast Vietnamese coffee sweetened with rich condensed milk over crushed ice.
